nodes.question: What are some benefits of integrating various smart technologies like smart grids, smart meters, and smart buildings in urban environments?
nodes.answer: The benefits of integrating smart technologies in urban environments include energy efficiency improvement, renewable energy adoption, pollution reduction, and real-time feedback on energy and material flow.
